column1: # gc_bare_poll_witnesses.tsv -- THE DECLARED WITNESS OF EVERY CREDITED BARE-POLL SITE (cto, row gc-the-116-bare-poll-
# `util_gc_safe_point_contract.py <witnesses> --write-bare-poll-table`, read by `--bare-poll`.  ONE ROW PER SITE the
# census credits with the bare form (util_gc_census.py safe-points --list-polled, form=x86_rt_gc_poll).  A row is named
# <template>:<callees>#<n>: the template, the callee names the census prints for the site, and the ordinal n among the
# sites of that template naming the same callees, in census order -- NO LINE NUMBER, so a re-flow or any move of a
# line never invalidates a row (the coo's pass-42 red, 2026-10-08).  The reading takes the site's current line from the
# census at every run and checks the witness's emission against it.  A witness is the smallest ref-carrying program whose
# emission reaches the site; UNWITNESSED is a site no program in the set reaches, NAMED and never counted green.
# The table is rewritten only when a site is added or removed, or a witness is lost.
